title: How Enterprise Sales Teams Can Get More Replies With Sendblue
summary: A green text with “Reply STOP” gets ignored. See how enterprise sales teams use Sendblue to text on iMessage and keep every thread in the CRM.
body_markdown:
Good reps notice what gets answered. So they skip the SMS platform and text prospects from their own iPhones.


The prospect sees a[blue bubble](https://www.sendblue.com/blog/blue-bubble-vs-green-bubble) , a first name, and no opt-out boilerplate. The prospect replies.


That works for the rep. It causes four problems for the team:


- **A rep leaves, and the history leaves too.** The new owner of the opportunity can't see what was promised, who was introduced, or where things stalled.
- **A manager can't tell who's been contacted.** The CRM shows no touch, so the lead looks untouched. Two reps may work the same account, or nobody does.
- **A rep with a full book forgets.** Forty open threads on a personal phone have no tasks, no reminders, and no next step on the record.
- **A stop request stays on one phone.** If a buyer asks a rep to stop texting, nobody else on the team knows.


Banning personal-phone texting doesn't fix this. Reps text from their phones because buyers answer there. Take that away and you lose the replies.


Sendblue brings iMessage into your sales workflow, so reps can send the[kind of messages](https://www.sendblue.com/blog/imessage-sales-scripts-templates) they would send from their own iPhones, directly from the[tools your team already uses](https://www.sendblue.com/blog/imessage-crm-integration) . It supports real iMessage delivery, CRM integrations, voice messages, and FaceTime Audio.
